missions.Title: Navami ki Raat
missions.Goal: Gaon ko Chhaya-bhooton se bachao, ghat tak pahuncho

Intro.line: Damodar ke kinare ek chhota gaon. Navami ki raat — har ghar me deepak, har aangan me naach.
Usi raat nadi ke neeche ke andhkar se Tamasur jaaga. Uski chhaayaayein gaon ki taraf badhne lagin.
Acharya Vasudev ka shishya Rishi, guru ka diya Trishul uthata hai. "Pehle gaon, phir kuch aur."

Outro.line: Ghat par pahunch kar Rishi ne dekha — Tamas ki chhaaya Acharya Vasudev ko utha le ja rahi thi.
Guru ki aakhri awaaz: "Rajrappa… jyoti bachao…" Rishi sangam ki or chal pada.

missions.Title: Sangam ki Chattanein
missions.Goal: Damodar-Bhairavi sangam ki chattanein paar karo

Intro.line: Rajrappa — jahan Bhairavi, Damodar se milti hai. Par raasta nadi ki fisalti chattanon se hokar jaata hai.

Outro.line: Chattanon ke paar mandir dikha. Uski akhand jyoti ab bas ek kaanpti lau thi.

missions.Title: Chhinnamastika ka Aangan
missions.Goal: Mandir ke aangan me Dhanush dhoondho, jyoti bachao

Intro.line: Mandir ke aangan me sona chamak raha tha — kisi purane yoddha ka Dhanush.

BossIntro.line: Wahan Tamasur ka senapati Andhvir khada tha — bhari gada, aur aankhon me sirf andhkar.

Outro.line: Andhvir gira, aur Rajrappa ki jyoti phir jal uthi.
Girte hue usne kaha: "Agla deep Kashi ka bujhega… aur tera guru Ellora ki gufaon me hai."

missions.Title: Deepon ki Seedhiyan
missions.Goal: Ghaton ki seedhiyan chadho, aasmaan ke Vayu-pishach giraao

Intro.line: Kashi ke ghat — hazaaron deepon wali seedhiyan. Par aaj aasmaan Vayu-pishachon se kaala tha.

Outro.line: Seedhiyon ke upar maha-aarti ke teen bade deep bujhe pade the. Aarti ruki, to Kashi andhere me doob jaayegi.

missions.Title: Ganga Aarti ki Raksha
missions.Goal: Aarti ke teeno maha-deep jalao — asur rokne aayenge

Intro.line: Rishi ko teeno maha-deep jalane the — aur Tamas ki sena use rokne ko taiyaar thi.

Outro.line: Teeno deep jale, aur Ganga par aarti ki roshni phail gayi.
Ek naavik ne bataya: dakshin me Hampi ke khandaharon me patthar ke asur jama ho rahe hain — Shilaasur ki sena.

missions.Title: Vijayanagara ke Khandahar
missions.Goal: Khandaharon se raasta banao, Shilaasur ko roko

Intro.line: Vijayanagara ke khandahar — pathar ka rath, toote mandap. Har chattan ke peeche Pashan-rakshas.

BossIntro.line: Rath ke saamne Shilaasur utha — Tamasur ka doosra senapati, jiska sharir hi patthar hai.

Outro.line: Shilaasur toota. Uske patthar par Ellora ki gufaon ka naksha khuda tha.
Rishi samajh gaya — guru wahin hain, Kailasa ki gufaon me.

missions.Title: Kailasa ki Gufayein
missions.Goal: Gufaon ke teen deep jalao, guru tak pahuncho

Intro.line: Ellora — ek hi pahad se kaata gaya Kailasa mandir. Andar ki gufaayein Tamas se bhari thin.

Outro.line: Aakhri gufa me Acharya Vasudev the. Teeno deep jalte hi Tamas ki zanjeerein toot gayin.
Guru bole: "Tamasur ka hriday wahin hai jahan se wo jaaga — Damodar ke neeche. Wahan jaana hoga."

missions.Title: Damodar ke Neeche
missions.Goal: Andhkar ke lok me utro, Tamasur ka saamna karo

Intro.line: Nadi ke neeche ek doosra lok — na din, na raat, sirf Tamas. Rishi guru ka ashirvad le kar utra.

BossIntro.line: Aur wahan, apne andhkar ke singhasan par, Tamasur ne aankhein kholin.

Outro.line: Tamasur ka andhkar bikhar gaya. Ek-ek karke Bharat ke saare teerthon ki jyoti laut aayi.
Navami ki subah gaon laut kar Rishi ne dekha — budhe chitrakar deewar par uski gaatha ka aakhri chitra bana rahe the.
